name: ❄️Twilight's Zone
desc:
✨ Twilight's Zone is a mind bending horror based experience featuring former famous Stars who remain permanent residents of the Twilight Tower Hotel! Survive and learn the mystery of why these Stars have been trapped here for so long! Unlock Star Characters and Relics to better advance through the game!

⚡USE CODE - VOLTS

🧡 Credits - Destact & rblxblank
⚠️ Notice - This game is in testing! Bugs may occur during your experience. Please report them to our Server so we can fix the issue you have ran into!
